title: DSWD releases aid to over 53,000 sugar farmers, workers in Negros

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) has distributed P553.89 million in financial assistance to 53,829 sugarcane farmers and farm workers affected by the red-striped soft scale insect (RSSI) infestation across Negros Island as of Oct. 16. DSWD Regional Director Arwin Razo said Monday that the beneficiaries included 48,001 sugarcane farmers and 5,828 farm laborers whose livelihoods were affected by the infestation. Negros Occidental received the bulk of the assistance, with P429.02 million distributed to 41,552 beneficiaries, comprising 40,266 farmers and 1,286 laborers across its legislative districts.
